6.quote: We present an open-source tool for automatic thrombus classification and test it on three selected clinical cases regarding functionality and classification runtime.

20.quote: We were able to evaluate our system on three new cases that were generated with another angiography unit than the training data

23.quote: The tests were conducted under Python 3.10.8, PyTorch 1.18, CUDA 11.7.1

27.quote: We utilize two models, one that was trained for frontal sequences, and another that was trained for lateral sequences. The final classification is the mean of both predictions.

37.quote: In all three cases, the first and second sequences were correctly classified as nonthrombus-free and thrombus-free.
